scope: host-only scene BVH: primitive leaf AABBs (bit-equal to frozen MJWarp reference), per-world grouped build/refit, host semantic ray-AABB query, rejection surface; no GPU traversal or ray-primitive hit semantics (S2b), no mesh triangle BVH (S3)

environment.product_native: not used by this slice (pure host test; no native-model-probe feature needed)
environment.product_gpu: not used; product tests never start Python and need no GPU

authoring.purpose: one-off offline capture of the frozen MJWarp reference (not part of product build/test/gate chain)
authoring.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, driver 596.36, sm_89
authoring.determinism: two full captures from fresh model/data/context are bitwise identical; second pass 0.078 s

reference_inputs.kernel_input_note: the AABB reference is produced from MJWarp device-side f32 geom poses (d.geom_xpos / d.geom_xmat); converted CPU MuJoCo poses can differ by 1 ULP, so the fixture records the exact f32 bit patterns fed to the kernel

aabb_parity.host_fma_implementation: (a as f64 * b as f64 + c as f64) as f32; f32::mul_add is not used because this target's debug-build fallback is not correctly rounded and differs from release

model_inputs.geom_size_f32_bits: 3.12 model-312.json f64 -> f32 bits equal to the 3.15 reference input bits (all 21 scalars)
model_inputs.mesh_bounds_f32_bits: mesh bounds computed from 3.12 mesh_vert f32 equal to the 3.15 reference mesh_bounds_size bits (3/3 scalars)

build_refit.build: per-world binned SAH (12 bins), children appended before parents
build_refit.refit: leaf bounds from new poses, then internal nodes in index order (children before parents)
invariants_checked: group root bounds == union of the group's leaf AABBs (initial and after refit)
every leaf reachable exactly once from its group root
every internal node bounds == union of its two children (semantic, no node-layout assertion)
initial vs moved changed leaf set == [1,2,3,4,5,6]; floor (geom 0) static

world_groups.test: two grouped worlds with identical (duplicated) leaf AABBs, matching MuJoCo nworld semantics

cases: empty mesh vertices / missing mesh bounds
leaf count overflow (node capacity 2*n-1 checked before allocation)

acceptance_mapping.plan_s2_3_refit_change: AABB layer pass (leaf bits equal + changed set matches); ray-layer hit changes belong to S2b
acceptance_mapping.plan_s2_4_world_groups: host semantic pass (candidates never cross world; 64/64 queries); GPU hit layer belongs to S2b

not_claimed: CUDA scene BVH traversal or ray-primitive hit semantics (S2b)
plan S2 acceptance item 1 (geomid/distance/normal per ray) and the ray layer of item 3
mesh triangle BVH / mesh hit distance-normals (S3); this slice only has the mesh bounds box
full renderer or product rendering acceptance
platform-independent IEEE fma on the host; host f64 product+sum path is a fixture-verified emulation
hfield AABB (out of scope) or full SDF semantics
unmet: rotated plane AABB path has no GPU bit reference because scene-a floor is static identity; covered only by the shared formula/unit tests
no fuzz or arbitrary-MJB property tests; single frozen scene-a fixture
host fma emulation may differ from CUDA fma.rn by <=1 ULP on arbitrary inputs; only the 56 captured leaves are verified bit-exact
AABB reference inputs are MJWarp device-side f32 poses; product integration must feed poses from the same GPU kinematics path (not CPU f64 poses)
leaf count overflow is covered by a pre-allocation capacity unit test; no real allocation of that size is attempted
hash_basis: artifact sha256/bytes/lines are LF-normalized content (committed git blob semantics), not the Windows working-tree CRLF forms
